# Slugger Athletics

> Custom team uniforms, sublimated jerseys, embroidered hats, and 3D hype chains for every sport. Designed and produced in Ocala, Florida, and shipped nationwide. In-house design (including an AI jersey maker), fast turnaround (2-3 weeks, ~1 week rush), no minimums on team stores, and free design with your order.

Contact: apparel@sluggerathletics.com · (352) 414-7270 · Ocala, FL · Mon-Fri 9-5 ET
Rating: 4.9 stars from 79 Google reviews

- [Design Studio / AI Jersey Maker](https://sluggerathletics.com/custom-jersey-maker): Create a custom jersey mockup online, free.

- [SquadLocker Alternative](https://sluggerathletics.com/squadlocker-alternative): How Slugger compares for fully custom team stores.
